rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an airplane.

example.english: We’re taking a plane to Taipei.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daap3 fei1 gei1 heoi3 toi4 bak1

rows.note: Use this for a geometric flat surface rather than an airplane.

example.jyutping: nei1 go3 ping4 min6 m4 hai6 lap6 tai2 ge3
